Sources, citations & data types

REAL = measured locations of individual birds (GPS, bands). DERIVED = computed from real GPS. MODELED = statistical estimate (eBird S&T), not individual birds.

  • REAL · Movebank (other waterfowl, not mallard): blueWingedTeal_USGS_ASC_argos. Ramey, A.M., Soos, C., Link, P., Walther, P., Tibbitts, T.L., and Douglas, D.C., 2019, Tracking Data for Blue-winged Teal (Anas discors), ver 1.0: U.S. Geological Survey, Alaska Science Center data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9Z9BA9F. Also Movebank study 446107870. License: Public domain (USGS data release); Movebank study open for download (license terms suspended)
  • REAL · USGS: Pearse, A.T., Szymanski, M., Anchor, C.E., Murano, R., and Stafford, J.D., 2023, Mallard migration and regional movement timing, distance, and direction data, 2018-2020: U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9GSUQUU. Public domain (CC0 1.0)
  • MODELED · eBird: eBird Status and Trends, Cornell Lab of Ornithology (ebirdst R package). Fink, D., T. Auer, A. Johnston, M. Strimas-Mackey, et al. eBird Status and Trends, Data Version: 2025. Cornell Lab of Ornithology, Ithaca, New York. Full author list, release year and DOI for this version: https://science.ebird.org/status-and-trends/data-access (the 2023 version is https://doi.org/10.2173/WZTW8903). Product: mallar3 weekly abundance (median), 9 km, 52 weeks; cropped to Montana bbox (-116.6, 43.8, -103.5, 49.5). Downloaded via st-download.ebird.org API. Model run: n/a. Terms: eBird Status & Trends data products — non-commercial use, attribution required. eBird Status & Trends terms of use (non-commercial, attribution)
  • Reference: Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com): admin-1 boundaries, rivers, lakes. Public domain Refuge markers are approximate centers, not boundaries.

Processing notes

  • NWI wetlands shown as a live USFWS map service (no 1.5 GB download needed); it draws only when zoomed in to roughly county scale (USFWS limit 1:236,000).
  • USGS MALL_dist_dir.csv: no coordinate columns found (562 rows) - summarized in report only.
  • USGS MALL_timing.csv: no coordinate columns found (6,098 rows) - summarized in report only.
  • USGS 2018-2020: 97 birds, 562 movements; release has distance & bearing but NO coordinates, so it cannot be drawn as tracks. Metadata extent starts at 103.4° W, east of Montana's border (~104.05° W): 0 locations in Montana.
  • Movebank 'blueWingedTeal_USGS_ASC_argos' (blueWingedTeal_USGS_ASC_argos.csv): 33,583 rows -> 33,583 after species/visible/outlier flags (other waterfowl, NOT mallard; kept in a separate layer).
  • Other-waterfowl GPS (Argos) cleaning: 33,583 fixes -> 33,533 after removing missing/invalid/duplicate -> 33,532 after speed-spike filter (>150 km/h in and out).
  • Other-waterfowl GPS (Argos) thinned to <= 1 fix/1 h per bird for analysis: 22,727 fixes.
  • Other waterfowl are Argos satellite fixes (error ~0.25 km to >10 km), so their stopovers are approximate; their top-10 list is limited to MT, ND, SD, AB, SK, ID.
  • eBird S&T: mallard_abundance_median_weekly_9km_MT_2025.tif, 17 duck-season weeks (09-26 to 01-19), ~9.0 km cells, clipped to Montana, reprojected to Web Mercator (nearest neighbour); colors log-scaled, fixed max = 99th pct (82.9).

USGS mallard movements, 2018–2020 REAL · summarized

97 juvenile mallards tagged in North & South Dakota (2018: 30, 2019: 67; 44 F / 53 M), 562 movements between 562 local use areas, 20 Sep–28 Feb.

Why it isn't on the map: the public release gives each movement's distance and compass bearing, but no latitude/longitude. Its extent begins at 103.4° W, east of Montana (border ≈104.05° W), so 0 of these birds' locations are in Montana.
